summary: Iteration 92: i18n language switching testing for Chutex Care preventative health app. Tested language switching across onboarding page, login page, and guardian dashboard. All 7 languages (FR, EN, ES, DE, IT, PT, NL) available in the LanguagePicker component. Language switching on onboarding and login pages WORKS CORRECTLY. Translations change dynamically when language is switched.

integration_issues.issue: Location permission modal blocks dashboard content. Dashboard loads but user must grant location permission to proceed. This is expected behavior but may hinder testing.
integration_issues.notes: Location permission is a browser feature - not a bug. Dashboard works when permission is granted.

critical_code_review_comments: I18nContext.tsx correctly contains ~140+ translation keys per language for all 7 languages (FR, EN, ES, DE, IT, PT, NL)
onboarding.tsx uses useI18n() hook - t('onboarding_tagline') and t('slide_start') - working correctly
index.tsx (login page) uses useI18n() - all login strings translated (t('login'), t('access_health_space'), t('sign_in'), etc.) - working correctly
LanguagePicker.tsx uses t('language') for popup title and correctly shows all 7 language options
devices.tsx uses t() for titles - integration appears correct
Tab labels in _layout.tsx do not show text labels (tabBarShowLabel: false) - they use icons only
context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n system using I18nContext.tsx with ~140+ keys per language. LanguagePicker component available on onboarding and login pages. Language switching confirmed working for: onboarding tagline, slide button text, login title, subtitle, button text, forgot password link, register link. Guardian dashboard shows French translations. Beneficiary dashboard blocked by location permission modal in browser testing environment.
